10 استفاض He asked for the pouring out (إِفَاضَة) of water, (K, TA,) &c. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Said of a piece of news: and of a place: see 1, in the first half of the paragraph. You say also, استفاض الوَادِى شَجَرًا (tropical:) The valley became wide, and abundant in trees. (S, O, K, TA.) ＝
-A3- استفاضوا الحَدِيثَ: see افاضوا فِى الحَدِيثِ. [It seems to be indicated in the S and O that it signifies They spread abroad the story among the people; as used by some: see مُسْتَفِيضٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
